body: J53 landed: research/J53_HANDBOOK_REAL_TERMS.md (+ CLAUDE_LAND_NOTE_J53.md; copies in _john_delivery/). Research only, no HANDOFF edit. Glossary.gd audit (46 entries): 1 WRONG (sanctioning merges commission and sanctioning body, split it), 9 MISLEADING (record, starting_cash, offer, purse, weigh_in, weight_cut, suspension, ranking, corner), 7 OK, 29 GAME-ONLY. Section 2.2 has replacement lines within the 15/12-word limits. Section 3 adds 18 missing first-month terms (bout, show, walkover, pre-bout medical, BCR1, headguard, standing count, Supervisor/OIC...). Also fixes J52: <=2 kg gap is only for England Boxing Minors/Schools (else within one weight category); England Boxing says Supervisor, not OIC.
